topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I uncover this box, this rusted knot in time, and everything inside is a stranger to me. How dare it sit there, mocking the passage of years, the layers of earth that kept it hidden? I didn't bury this. Could I have forgotten it so completely? Or is this someone else’s past, thrust into the present, daring me to untangle the threads? The contents spill out—papers, a few coins, a small, broken watch. They’re cold, these items, as if they’ve been waiting to tell me a story I don’t want to hear. I’ll sort through this mess, but every piece feels like a challenge, a gauntlet thrown down by the shadows of the past.
